decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details of materials required by condition 2 and details of boundary treatments required by condition 6 of planning permission 00129/2/P3 dated 13/07/2009 (as listed in the schedule) for the demolition of the existing dwelling and erection of five bedroom house over basement, and erection of a detached garden room and creation of new vehicular access onto Spencer Road; are satisfactory as they are in keeping with the style of the originally approved building and would provide high quality, durable finishes, complementary to the appearance and character of the area.

Schedule of supporting information

	Roof tiles - 'Marley Double Camber Acme Antique Clay' plain tile (red)

Windows - Traditional timber frame painted casements with double glazed panels by 'Bereco'

	Facing Brickwork - 'Ibstock: Ivanhoe Burnt Red'

Vertical Tile Hanging - 'Marley Double Camber Acme Antique Clay' plain tile (red)

Render - 'Monocouche one coat through coloured render' (white)

Patios - Indian sandstone slabs

Paths - Granite setts

Bolton Road frontage - Timber driveway access gate, brick piers to side of pedestrian gate with remainder of existing brick wall retained.

Spencer Road frontage - Timber driveway access gate, existing brick wall made good and retained, replacement of existing timber pedestrian access gate with new gate to match existing.

Side boundaries - Existing timber boarded fencing retained and made good.

	Drawing 1032 10.01 Revision C3 received 9 May 2011
description: Details of materials required by condition 2 and details of boundary treatments required by condition 6 of planning permission 00129/2/P3 dated 13/07/2009 for the demolition of existing dwelling and erection of five bedroom house over basement. Erection of detached garden room and creation of new vehicular access onto Spencer Road.
